title: The libsufr public API can gain a field, variant or error kind without breaking callers
body:
libsufr 0.8.0 exports these items in a form that breaks callers when it changes. Each later field, variant or error kind then costs a major version.

| item | where | what breaks a caller |
|---|---|---|
| `SeedMask` | `format.rs` | The fields `mask`, `bytes` and `positions` are `pub`. A caller can build a mask whose three fields disagree. |
| `OpenOptions`, `Context`, `Location`, `Extraction` | `lib.rs`, `search.rs` | Every field is `pub` and none of them is `#[non_exhaustive]`. A new field breaks a struct literal or a pattern. |
| `SourceKind`, `Alphabet` | `typed.rs`, `build.rs` | Exhaustive enums. A new variant breaks every `match`. `Alphabet::Dna { ignore_softmask }` is a struct variant. |
| `OUTFILE_VERSION` | `format.rs` | Exported at the crate root, outside the `typed` feature. The `sufr` CLI does not use it. |
| `TypedSuffixArray` | `typed.rs`, behind `typed` | Its one public method is `open`. Its search and read methods are `pub(crate)`, and nothing turns it into a `SuffixArray`. |
| `anyhow::Result` | every fallible function | A caller cannot match on the kind of error. |

## Proposal

- Mark `OpenOptions`, `Context`, `Location`, `Extraction`, `SourceKind` and `Alphabet` `#[non_exhaustive]`.
- Make the fields of `SeedMask` private. A caller builds one with `SeedMask::new` and reads it through methods.
- Stop exporting `OUTFILE_VERSION` at the crate root, or move it behind `typed`.
- Return a libsufr error enum in place of `anyhow::Result`.

## Cost

Each change in the proposal breaks callers on its own, so they belong in one release. `#[non_exhaustive]` stops another crate from writing a struct literal. `OpenOptions` has a `Default` impl and keeps working through `..Default::default()`. `Context` has no `Default` and would need a constructor. `Location` and `Extraction` come out of `Hits`, and we have not checked whether any caller builds one.

## Open

- Does `TypedSuffixArray` get public search and read methods, or does the `typed` feature stop exporting it?

## Out of scope

sufr-ce174c listed these beside the items above. They concern cost or correctness rather than what breaks a caller.

- `SuffixArray::text`, `suffixes` and `lcps` return new `Vec`s, and `Hits::locate` and `Hits::extract` collect. No issue covers this yet.
- `SuffixArrayBuilder::from_data` checks nothing about its text. sufr-b96ee1 covers one result of that.
- libsufr parses FASTA itself with `needletail`. sufr-409cc8 compares readers.
- `SuffixArray::open_with` writes a cache to `~/.sufr`. That is sufr-22b9c3.
